website.note: Pipeline focused on emavusertib (CA-4948) lead asset

pipeline.license_origin: Licensed from Aurigene under 2015 collaboration (IRAK4 program)

indications.indication: Relapsed/refractory primary CNS lymphoma (R/R PCNSL), in combination with ibrutinib
indications.trial_design: Open-label, single-arm dose escalation/expansion of emavusertib + ibrutinib in R/R hematologic malignancies including PCNSL
key_milestones: Orphan Drug Designation granted by EMA (Jul 2024) and FDA (Dec 2024) for PCNSL
Mar 2025: productive CHMP and FDA meetings supporting potential CMA (EU) and Accelerated Approval NDA (US) paths from this single-arm study
Confirmatory study design alignment required prior to CMA/NDA submission

indications.indication: Frontline chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL), in combination with zanubrutinib
indications.trial_design: Phase 2 open-label combination study of emavusertib + zanubrutinib in frontline CLL
indications.trial_status: Recruiting (sites activated Q4 2025; dosing initiation H1 2026)

indications.indication: Acute myeloid leukemia (AML) / myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS) — monotherapy and combinations
indications.trial_design: Dose escalation/expansion of emavusertib monotherapy and combinations (e.g., venetoclax) in AML/MDS
indications.trial_status: Suspended — programs substantially complete; further development contingent on additional funding (per Jan 2026 strategic update)
key_milestones: Jan 2026: company announced focus shift to PCNSL and CLL; AML/MDS work substantially complete pending additional funding

excluded_preclinical: CA-327 (PD1/TIM3 small molecule antagonist) — early/preclinical Aurigene-licensed program
excluded_legacy_terminated: Fimepinostat (CUDC-907) — completed/discontinued lymphoma and solid tumor studies (NCT01742988, NCT02674750, NCT02307240, NCT02909777)
CUDC-101 — terminated/completed early-stage HDAC/EGFR/HER2 inhibitor (NCT01384799, NCT01702285, NCT00728793, NCT01171924)
CI-8993 (anti-VISTA antibody) — Phase 1 completed (NCT04475523), no active development disclosed
CA-170 — partner-controlled (Aurigene worldwide rights, royalty-only to Curis)
excluded_partner_owned: CA-170 (oral PD-L1/PD-L2/VISTA antagonist) — Aurigene holds worldwide development/commercialization rights as of Sep 2024 amendment; Curis entitled to royalties only
